question: Should `@openclaw/retry` become a supported Plugin SDK import surface, or remain an internal workspace package used by core and bundled code only?
rationale: The branch wires the package into Plugin SDK declarations and extension aliases, so merging it may create a long-lived compatibility obligation rather than only consolidating internal implementation.

options.title: Keep It Internal
options.body: Retain the shared scheduler but remove plugin-facing declaration and alias exposure until a supported SDK contract is intentionally approved.

options.title: Approve SDK Exposure
options.body: Accept `@openclaw/retry` as supported plugin API and add explicit documentation and compatibility-focused package tests before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep It Internal
recommendation.body: Retain the shared scheduler but remove plugin-facing declaration and alias exposure until a supported SDK contract is intentionally approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work is the strongest available feature-history signal for the retry contract, although official Plugin SDK ownership remains uncertain.
